remarks: City living in the heart of downtown Stamford. Updated Studio Apartment 2nd floor walkup overlooking historic Columbus Park located in the heart of downtown Stamford. Charming exposed brick walls, hard wood floors, high ceilings. UTILITIES INCLUDED IN RENT: Heat, Electric, Garbage, Water, & AC. Coin operated laundry located on same floor down the hall. Enjoy Downtown living at its best, Main Street dining, Nightlife, Movie Theater, Shops, Mall, City bus service less than a block away, Half mile to Stamford Train Station. Paid monthly Parking space available in Public garage in back of building. Don't miss this gem.
